title: 第7章 梦境具现化第8章 摄魂与御魂
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
【五大圣地，组建了正道联盟。
【势必要荡平天下魔修。
【而你的炼魂殿，因最近声名鹊起。
【也被列为讨伐的对象。
【而这个时期。
【恰逢祝蝶真即将渡劫。
【成功之后，便能够跻身飞升境。
【这可是无数修士梦寐以求的阶段。
【这个时代中，上一个出现飞升境修士的时期，还是在五千年前。
【一旦祝蝶真成功，那绝对能够名动整个修真界。
【但同样的，渡劫也十分危险。
【稍有不慎，便会身死道消。
【你不想祝蝶真分心，便没有将这个消息告诉她。
【并命令全部宗门对此事闭口不谈。
【为了安全起见，你又亲自为祝蝶真挑选了一个隐秘的地方。
【供其好好修炼。
【并骗她说，马上自己也要闭关，冲击飞升境。
【最多百年，待到飞升后见。
【祝蝶真信以为真。
【于是开始闭关渡劫。

【而你则带领着宗门所有魔修，抵御正道来袭。
【但任凭你如何努力。
content_en:
[The Five Holy Lands formed the Righteous Path Alliance.
【It is bound to bring down the demonic cultivators in the world.
[And your Soul Refining Hall has become famous recently.
[Also listed as a target of crusade.
【And this period.
[It just so happens that Zhu Diezhen is about to survive the catastrophe.
[After success, you will be able to enter the Ascension Realm.
[This is the stage that countless monks dream of.
[In this era, the last time there were Ascension Realm monks was five thousand years ago.
[Once Zhu Diezhen succeeds, it will definitely become famous in the entire world of cultivation.
[But similarly, overcoming the tribulation is also very dangerous.
[If you are not careful, you will die.
[You didn’t want Zhu Diezhen to be distracted, so you didn’t tell her the news.
[And ordered all sects to keep silent about this matter.
[For safety reasons, you personally chose a secret place for Zhu Diezhen.
[Let him practice well.
[And he lied to her that he would also go into seclusion soon and reach the ascension realm.
[At most a hundred years, see you after you ascend.
[Zhu Die really believes it is true.
[So I started to retreat to survive the tribulation.
[And you lead all the demon cultivators in the sect to resist the attack of the righteous path.
[But no matter how hard you try.
